title: NeuronCompanionTelemetryEvent
description: Structured telemetry emitted by the Neuron companion (F0038-S0008, extended by F0040/ADR-037). Covers renewal adoption signals and PII-minimized specialist-head outcome/latency. Modeled on the F0035 SessionContinuityEvent ingest pattern (ADR-024). Fire-and-forget: emission failure MUST NOT break the user flow. Carries only stable internal correlation ids and bounded metric fields — never user text, event descriptions, component props, draft bodies, raw prompts/responses, credentials, email, name, or IP.

event_name.description: needs-attention-surfaced (primary start) and draft-ready (primary end) bracket the baseline metric; the rest are the minimal secondary v1 set. Edit-distance and compliance-violation tracking are explicitly deferred.

user_id.description: Stable internal UserId per ADR-006; IdP-agnostic, safe to log.

renewal_id.description: Renewal correlation. The same renewal_id correlates needs-attention-surfaced (start) and draft-ready (end) to compute the duration; a surfaced renewal with no paired draft-ready is measurable as 'not actioned' (no fabricated end timestamp).

persona.description: Renewal-owner persona context for DAU; required on companion-daily-active.

head_run_id.description: Optional Neuron agent-run correlation for an executed head; omitted for a route rejected before a head run.

entry_point.description: Whether the attempt came from Day at a Glance or direct conversational routing.

terminal_result.description: Bounded terminal result; contains no component props or failure detail.

latency_ms.description: Monotonic elapsed execution time in whole milliseconds.
